mapper.select: SELECT order_id, goods_id, buyer_id, seller_id, order_status, create_time FROM orders ORDER BY create_time DESC, order_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (goods_id, buyer_id, seller_id, order_status, create_time) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{orderStatus}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, goods_id, buyer_id, seller_id, order_status, create_time FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, g.status AS goodsStatus, o.buyer_id AS buyerId, bu.username AS buyerName, o.seller_id AS sellerId, su.username AS sellerName, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.create_time AS createTime FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON o.goods_id = g.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON o.buyer_id = bu.user_id LEFT JOIN `user` su ON o.seller_id = su.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC
WHERE o.seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC

AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC, o.order_id DESC
